propositions: CodeQL reports two high-severity alerts on lines 249 and 250 of test_llm_fallback_chain.py for incomplete URL substring sanitization using startswith on URL strings
The assertion uses prefix matching (startswith) on hard-coded URL constants, which incorrectly accepts hosts that share the prefix such as https://fallback.test.evil.example/
The test intends to verify that a fallback model was built against the configured endpoint, but only checks that base_url starts with the endpoint bytes rather than comparing the URL origin exactly
The fix replaces startswith comparisons with exact equality checks on parsed URL origins (scheme, netloc) via urllib.parse.urlsplit to eliminate substring ambiguity
After the fix, CodeQL re-scanning confirms both alerts transition to state=fixed, bringing open alerts on the repository to zero
